slides.notes:
This one is long on purpose so you can check scroll.

1. The slide should sit on the strip, not overlap it.
2. The strip stays full width of the stage (right of the rail).
3. Bottom padding still clears the floating dock.
4. Changing slides replaces these notes.
5. Grid (G) covers this; Present still opens a new tab.

If the dock overlaps the editor, the 72px clearance failed.
If the slide letterboxes oddly, the fit slot is wrong.
If typing arrows the deck, stopPropagation on the editor failed.
Walk the before/after. Then Present and check the console still shows these notes read-only.
